WPSS 1135/2026
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Kishore Rai, Advocate, for 
the petitioner. 
Mr. Manoj Kumar, Central Govt. 
Standing Counsel, for the respondents. 
(2) Petitioner was recruited as 
Constable (GD) in ITBP and he was sent 
for training to Recruit Training Centre, 
Karera (Madhya Pradesh). On petitioner’s 
request, he was assigned another 
training centre in State of Arunachal 
Pradesh, namely, Recruit Training 
Centre, Kimming. According to 
petitioner, he reported to Recruit 
Training Centre, Kimming on 26.3.2026, 
but he was not permitted to enter the 
training centre and thereafter he made a 
representation to Commandant, Recruit 
Training Centre, Kimming by registered 
post from the Post Office North 
Lakhimpur (Arunachal Pradesh) on 
27.3.2026, but no progress is made so 
far. By means of this writ petition, 
petitioner has sought the following 
reliefs:
“i. Issue a writ, order or 
direction in the nature of mandamus 
commanding the respondent to permit 
the petitioner to undergo/complete his 
basic recruitment training recruitment 
training Centre at Kimming Arunachal 
Pradesh. ii. Issue a writ, order or 
direction in the nature of mandamus 
commanding and directing the 
respondent no. 4 and 5 to ensure the fair 
treatment at Recruitment Training Centre 
at Kimming Arunachal Pradesh so that 
the petitioner completed his training at 
the training centre and to return the 
articles of the petitioner.” 
(3) Having regard to the facts and 
circumstances of the case, Commandant, 
Recruit Training Centre, Kimming is 
directed either to permit the petitioner to 
undergo training or to show cause by 
filing counter affidavit, within three 
weeks. 
(4) List on 25.5.2026.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 28.4.2026
